title: Billing
subtitle: Manage your subscription and payments
trialExpiry: Once it expires, you'll need to upgrade to keep using Pro features.
freeDescription: Use the core features for free. Upgrade for full access.
noPaymentsHint: Once you pay and upload a receipt, it will appear here.
paypalNote: Include your reference in the PayPal message. You get the reference on the pricing page after signing in.
activationNote: After payment, upload a receipt on the pricing page. Pro access is activated manually, usually within a few hours.
invoiceInstructions1: 1. Transfer the amount to the bank account listed above.
invoiceInstructions2: 2. Make sure to include invoice number {{invoiceNumber}} as the payment reference.
invoiceInstructions3: 3. After paying, return to the app, confirm "I've paid" and upload a receipt so Pro can be activated.
invoiceFooter: Thank you for supporting MathDigitizer Pro!
payModalSubtitle: Pay by bank transfer with an invoice — local, simple, no card required.
payModalReferenceNote: Include the invoice number as the payment reference when transferring.
payModalBankNote: Transfer to the account below, then confirm.
payModalUploadHint: Upload an image of your payment confirmation (screenshot or photo).
payModalUploadTooLarge: The image is too large. Try a smaller resolution.
payModalUploadFailed: Failed to upload the receipt. Please try again.
payModalSuccessTitle: Your payment was submitted for review!
payModalSuccessMessage: We'll verify the payment within 24 hours. Pro access is activated once approved and you'll get an email.
payModalRequiresLogin: Sign in with Google to generate an invoice and track your payment status.
payModalInvoiceOpened: The invoice opened in a new tab — save it as PDF via the print dialog.
payModalPopupBlocked: Your browser blocked the new tab. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.
payAdminSubtitle: Review, approve or reject bank-transfer payments for MathDigitizer Pro.
payAdminNoAccess: You don't have access to this dashboard. Only payment administrators can view it.
payAdminRejectSuccess: Payment rejected and the user was notified.
payAdminActionError: The action failed. Please try again.
